Our Story

A Journey of Innovation and Collaboration

Siva's Entrepreneurial Journey
Siva, a seasoned entrepreneur, founded PowerUpCloud in 2015 and successfully sold it
to Larsen & Toubro Infotech (LTI) in 2019. Upon completion of his engagement with LTI
in 2022, he identified the transformative potential of AI in the field of data analysis.


The Birth of Lyzr
Inspired by ChatGPT, Siva envisioned a product where users could upload CSV or Excel
files and ask questions, receiving insights and recommendations in return. As he
discussed this idea with potential customers, Siva realized the paramount importance of
data privacy. Additionally, he found the existing platform, LangChain, inadequate for his
vision. This led to the birth of Lyzr in April 2023, derived from the word “analyzer.”
Lyzr was initially focused on creating an AI product for data analysis but soon pivoted to
developing an agent framework by October 2023.
An agent framework, as Siva saw it, was a platform to build AI agents capable of
autonomously performing tasks based on given inputs. The rise of chat-based agents
during late 2023 solidified this direction.
Lyzr began with chat agents and knowledge search agents, eventually expanding into
workflow automation. Key innovations include the AI SDR (Sales Development
Representative) for sales, Skott for marketing automation, and Diane, an HR-specific
agent, each designed to optimize and streamline essential business functions.


Building the Team
Siva reunited with Anirudh, a long-time friend and colleague, who brought technical
expertise and shared vision. Jimmy, another friend, joined as CTO with his strong
technical background.

Together, the team of 50+ operates across the US and India, creating innovative AI
solutions. Lyzr's mission is to redefine what's possible through the power of AI agents.
United by a common goal and diverse expertise, team Lyzr continues to push the
boundaries of AI, creating innovative solutions that redefine what’s possible.



                              Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                 6
Technological Advancements
Lyzr's development has been closely tied to advancements in AI technology. The
emergence of large language models like ChatGPT has played a pivotal role in enabling
Lyzr to create powerful and versatile AI agents. By leveraging these models, Lyzr can
provide natural language understanding, generate human-like text, and complete
complex tasks.

Product Evolution
Lyzr's product has evolved from its initial focus on data analysis to a broader platform
capable of automating various tasks. The company's agent framework allows for the
creation of customized AI agents that can be tailored to specific needs and industries.
This flexibility has enabled Lyzr to expand its offerings and target a wider range of
customers.

Impact on Industries
Lyzr's technology has the potential to transform a wide range of industries. In the sales
domain, Lyzr's AI SDR can automate lead generation and qualification tasks, freeing up
sales teams to focus on high-value activities. In customer service, Lyzr's AI agents can
provide 24/7 support and handle routine inquiries, improving customer satisfaction.
Additionally, Lyzr's technology can be applied to areas such as marketing, finance, and
operations to streamline processes and drive efficiency.


Future Outlook
As AI technology continues to advance, Lyzr is well-positioned to capitalize on emerging
opportunities. The company's focus on innovation and adaptability will be crucial in
ensuring its long-term success. Lyzr's future may include exploring new applications for
its technology, expanding into international markets, and forming strategic partnerships
with other companies.


Lyzr's journey from a data analysis tool to a versatile AI platform is a testament to the
power of innovation and the potential of AI to revolutionize industries. By leveraging
cutting-edge technology and building a strong team, Lyzr is poised to become a leader in
the AI space.

Chapter One:
At-Will Employment and General
Conduct Standards

We are committed to the highest standards of conduct at every level, and we depend
upon the personal and professional integrity and dedication of all employees to help
uphold these standards. Your character and helpful behavior are assets and a credit to
Lyzr. To help maintain a positive work environment for you and your co-workers, we rely
on you to behave according to the provisions set forth in this Employee Handbook and in
other Lyzr policies and directives.
Failure to comply with Lyzr guidelines may result in disciplinary action, up to and
including termination of employment.


This Employee Handbook is not intended to address every situation that might arise but
is intended to highlight Lyzr’s expectations regarding your conduct in general. Nothing in
this Employee Handbook alters our at-will employment policy, which is set forth below.
This Employee Handbook is intended to provide employees and managers with general
guidelines for conduct and behavior in the workplace. Lyzr reserves the right, with or
without notice, in an individual case or generally, to change and/or modify its
interpretation of or revise, modify, delete, or add to any and all policies, procedures, work
rules, or benefits stated in this Employee Handbook or in any other document. Any
written changes to this Employee Handbook will be distributed to all employees so that
employees will be aware of the new policies or procedures.


This Employee Handbook supersedes and replaces any and all prior employee
handbooks and any prior inconsistent verbal or written policy statements. If any term of
this Employee Handbook conflicts with applicable state or local law, state or local law
shall control.




                               Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                   15
At-Will Employment




You are employed on an at-will basis, except where a written agreement is signed by
you and Lyzr’s CEO and expressly disclaims your at-will status. This at-will employment
policy means that, in the absence of such an agreement, either you or the Company may
terminate the employment relationship at any time, for any reason, with or without cause
or notice. Nothing in this Employee Handbook shall limit the right to terminate
employment at will. In addition, it means that, in the absence of a written agreement to
the contrary, the terms and conditions of your employment, including, but not limited to,
your compensation, benefits, duties, schedule, and location of work may also be
changed at any time in Lyzr’s sole discretion, with or without cause, and with or without
advance notice, and you may be transferred, promoted, or demoted, with or without
cause, and with or without advance notice.




                              Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                16
Anti-Harassment and Discrimination




Harassment Free Workplace
We are committed to creating an inclusive, respectful, courteous work environment free
of discrimination and harassment of any kind, and we are committed to taking all
reasonable steps to prevent and address discrimination and harassment if and when it
occurs. We will not tolerate discrimination or harassment, including but not limited to
those relating to any characteristic protected under applicable law by any employee,
contractor, vendor, customer, or visitor. These policies apply any time employees are at
work or attending work-related events. Employees are also reminded that even off-work
conduct can affect the workplace; discriminatory or harassing behavior outside of work
that affects the workplace may also be a basis for discipline up to and including
termination.


Individuals who believe that they have been subjected to harassment, discrimination, or
sexual assault by any manager, supervisor, team member, vendor, or client of Lyzr, and
any team members who have witnessed what they believe to be harassment or
discrimination, must report the situation immediately to their manager or any other Lyzr
manager. No team member, including managers, is exempt from this policy.




                             Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                17
Lyzr does not tolerate any retaliation against any employee who makes a good faith
report of harassment or discrimination. Furthermore, Lyzr will maintain the
confidentiality of reporting employees to the greatest extent possible. However, in order
to conduct a complete, thorough investigation, it may not be possible to maintain
complete confidentiality.


All harassment claims are investigated in a timely, objective, and thorough manner as
confidentially as possible. Lyzr will conduct or direct that a fair, timely, and thorough
investigation occurs as appropriate. Investigations will be impartial, documented, and
conducted by qualified personnel. All employees are encouraged to document incidents
of potential discrimination, harassment, or sexual assault and are expected to cooperate
fully in any investigation. If it is determined that this policy has been violated, Lyzr will
take appropriate disciplinary action or corrective measures, including, but not limited to,
mandatory counseling, training, additional supervision, transfer, change of job duties,
demotion, suspension, or termination of employment. This list of potential corrective
actions is illustrative only. Lyzr will determine the type of corrective action necessary to
remedy any situation created by a violation of our policy against harassment and
discrimination.



Protection Against Retaliation
Lyzr will not tolerate any form of retaliation against any employee who, in good faith,
opposes discrimination or prohibited harassment, makes a complaint, or participates in
any manner in an internal investigation or an investigation, proceeding, or hearing
conducted by a state or federal agency or court. Any employee who engages in
retaliation will be subject to disciplinary action, up to and including termination of
employment.



Bullying Free Workplace
Lyzr is proud of its professional and congenial work environment and does not tolerate
bullying behaviors of any kind.


Lyzr defines bullying as “repeated inappropriate behavior, either direct or indirect,
whether verbal, physical or otherwise, conducted by one or more persons against
another or others, at the place of work and/or in the course of employment.”




                               Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                   18
If you witness or are subjected to any conduct you believe violates this policy, you must
speak, write, or otherwise contact your manager or another Lyzr manager.


Lyzr does not tolerate any retaliation against any employee who makes a good faith
report of bullying. Furthermore, Lyzr will maintain the confidentiality of reporting
employees to the greatest extent possible. However, in order to address the situation, it
may not be possible to maintain complete confidentiality.


Anyone found to be engaging in any type of bullying in violation of this policy may be
subject to appropriate corrective and/or disciplinary action, up to and including
termination.

Code of Business Ethics and Conduct




Lyzr has a responsibility to conduct its business in strict compliance with all applicable
laws and regulations. Lyzr requires employees to act in accordance with the highest
standards of business ethics both on and off Lyzr premises, to avoid any appearance of
impropriety, and to observe all applicable laws and regulations while conducting
business on Lyzr’s behalf. You are expected to abide by the spirit as well as the letter of
this Code. You are also expected to cooperate with any inquiries or investigations
concerning a possible or suspected violation of this Code. Any employee’s failure to fulfill
their responsibilities under this Code may result in disciplinary action, up to and including
termination of employment.




                               Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                   20
Ethical Standards
Lyzr is committed to conducting business in a fair and open manner within the spirit and
letter of the law, with the highest regard for customers, the community, and employees.
Lyzr’s success depends not only on the knowledge, skills, and abilities of employees, but
also on sound judgment, self-discipline, common sense, and integrity. As such, all
employees are required to maintain and uphold the following common ethical standards:


   To pursue Lyzr objectives in a manner that does not conflict with the integrity of Lyzr
   or the public interest;
   To be truthful and accurate in all you say and do;
   To protect confidential information;
   To treat fellow employees with respect and dignity;
   To observe all laws, regulations, ordinances, and rules applicable to the operation of
   the business;
   To maintain honest and fair relationships with all employees, contractors and
   vendors;
   To ensure quality and value in Lyzr’s products/services and relationships with
   customers and vendors;
   To avoid, during the course of your employment, any situations that may engender
   any conflict between the personal interests of employees and the business interests
   of Lyzr, except to the extent the law permits otherwise; and
   To avoid creating a disruptive, unprofessional, or unproductive working
   environment.


Nothing in this Employee Handbook prohibits employees from discussing the terms or
conditions of their employment with other employees or engaging in any concerted
activities protected by the National Labor Relations Act or under applicable state law.




Conflict of Interest
Lyzr insists on the undivided loyalty of all employees, including management and non-
management staff, except to the extent that doing so would be inconsistent with
applicable law. Subject to that caveat, employees must not engage in any conduct, and
must avoid situations that would create an actual or potential conflict of interest or
create the appearance of such a conflict.


                              Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                 21
Conflicts of interest arise when an employee’s personal activity or personal interest is
contrary to the interests of Lyzr. These personal activities or interests may influence the
employee's judgment, causing the employee to make decisions based upon the
potential for personal gain, rather than in the best interests of Lyzr.


    To prevent conflicts of interest, the following behavior is deemed unacceptable and
    unethical, except to the extent the law provides otherwise:
    Receiving or giving of merchandise, money, services, travel, accommodations, or
    lavish entertainment that might appear to have been given to influence a business
    decision. Gifts offered or received at any time that are of more than minimal or token
    value shall not be accepted and shall be returned to the sender with an appropriate
    explanatory note or letter.
    Maintaining personal, business, or financial relationships with a customer or vendor
    where the employee has control or influence over Lyzr’s relationship with that
    customer or vendor. For example, employees should not borrow from or lend
    personal funds to a customer or vendor of the employee's division.
    Using information developed or learned on the job for personal or familial benefit.
    This includes the use of Lyzr databases, financial information, and intellectual
    property.
    Maintaining outside directorship, employment, or political office that might appear to
    or actually conflict or compete with an employee's responsibilities.
    Conducting Lyzr business with or using position or authority to influence Lyzr to
    conduct business with, family members.
    Unauthorized sharing of confidential or proprietary Lyzr information with business
    associates or representatives of other companies.
    All employees must gain prior written approval (from the head of the People Team)
    for any external employment, contract, consulting, vendor, etc. while employed with
    Lyzr.


The list above serves only to illustrate sources of possible conflicts of interest and does
not constitute a complete list of all the situations that may result in a conflict of interest.
Ultimately, it is the responsibility of each employee to avoid any situation that could affect
their ability to judge situations independently and objectively, and any situation that
could even appear to be a conflict of interest. It is important to note that under certain
circumstances, conflicts of interest can amount to violations of criminal law. If you are
unsure if an activity or situation may present a conflict of interest, you must bring the
matter to your manager as soon as possible.




                                Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                    22
Employment of Relatives and Significant Others
A familial relationship among employees can create an actual or a potential conflict of
interest. Relatives of an employee will be considered for employment on the basis of
their qualifications. However, to the extent permitted by applicable law, Lyzr may refuse
to hire or place a relative in a position when the potential for favoritism or conflict exists.


Additionally, the same general considerations apply if two employees marry or become
involved in a domestic-partner or personal relationship. If two employees marry or
become involved in a domestic-partner or personal relationship, they must immediately
disclose this changed circumstance to their manager or any other Lyzr manager.


Recognizing & Reporting a Conflict
It is essential that all employees pay close attention to possible violations of the Code of
Business Ethics and Conduct, whether they occur because of an oversight or
intentionally. Any employee who is aware of possible violations should notify their
manager, another Lyzr manager, or the People Team. If you are not sure whether there
is an ethical problem, you must ask your manager or the People Team.


Violation of the Code
Violations of this Code will be grounds for discharge or other disciplinary action, adapted
to the circumstances of the particular violation. Disciplinary action will be taken against
individuals who authorize or participate directly in a violation of the Code. Disciplinary
action also may be taken against any of the violator's managerial superiors, to the extent
that the circumstances of the violation reflect inadequate supervision and leadership by
the superior.


Complaints of Retaliation as a Result of Disclosure
Lyzr has a zero-tolerance policy for retaliation. If an employee or applicant believes that
they have been retaliated against for disclosing information regarding misconduct under
the Code, they should report it to any Lyzr manager or any Lyzr officer.

Lyzr encourages employees to come forward with any safety, ethical, or legal concerns.
Retaliation against those who bring forward these types of related concerns or
complaints, or those who assist in raising complaints, is strictly prohibited.




                                Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                    23
Additional Workplace Policies




Endorsements and Solicitations
To avoid disruption of operations, employees may not solicit for any cause or purpose
(including politics) during employee working time (which refers to time in which either
the solicitor or solicitee is working, but does not include rest periods, meal periods or any
other times when employees are properly not engaged in performing their work tasks).
Lyzr also prohibits distribution of materials for any cause in working areas or while on
work time. No employee should imply endorsement by Lyzr for a particular product or
service without proper authorization.


This policy is not intended to restrict communications or actions protected by local,
state, or federal law. This policy also does not restrict solicitations expressly authorized
by Lyzr.


                               Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                   24
Electronic Communications
Lyzr provides you with various communication tools and other business equipment.
Examples include Slack, email, voicemail, computers, etc. You are to use such devices
for business purposes. These electronic communication tools and company-related
work records belong to Lyzr and not to the employee. Lyzr routinely monitors use of
company-provided internet, equipment, technology, and e-mail for legitimate business
purposes and at any time with or without prior notice. Accordingly, employees have no
reasonable expectation of privacy when they use the company-provided internet,
equipment, communication system and e-mail. Additionally, internal, and external
emails and Slack conversations are considered business records and may be subject to
discovery in the event of litigation. Be aware of this possibility when sending email within
and outside the company.


While incidental personal use of such equipment is allowed, it should not interfere with
productivity or business demands. Unauthorized or illegal use or communications may
be subject to disciplinary action up to and including termination of employment.



Use of Cell Phones
Lyzr requires the safe use of cell phones by employees who use them to conduct Lyzr
business. Employees are required to obey all applicable state and local laws regarding
cell phone use while driving.


Under no circumstances should employees use a cellular telephone to send, receive or
review text messages, email or information over the Internet while driving.



Information Security
Lyzr requires all employees and contractors to take an active role in Information
Security. Everyone is required to stay up to date on all Security Policies, Procedures and
Security Training to help Lyzr keep its security certifications. Employees are required to
sign additional security policy acknowledgments, including but not limited to the User
Security Policy and Acceptable Use Policy.




                               Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                  25
Confidential Information
As an employee, you may learn information that is not known by the general public. You
may have access to confidential or proprietary information regarding Lyzr, its vendors,
its customers, or perhaps even fellow employees. Confidential or proprietary information
includes, but is not limited to business plans, strategies, budgets, projections, forecasts,
financial and operating information, business contracts, databases, employee
information, customer and vendor information, compensation data, advertising and
marketing plans, proposals, training materials and methods, and other information not
available to the public. This includes content uploaded into our system by customers and
partners.

Regardless of whether this type of information is specifically identified as confidential, it
is each employee's responsibility to keep this information in confidence. This is an
ongoing obligation that does not end even if your employment with Lyzr ends. You must
not use, reveal, or divulge any such information unless it is necessary for you to do so in
the performance of your duties (or except as otherwise allowed, if at all, by applicable
law). Generally, access to confidential information should be granted/provided/given on
a “need-to-know” basis and must be authorized by your manager. Only designated
personnel may make comments to any media requests.

All employees, contractors and temporary employees will also need to sign a
Proprietary Information and Inventions Agreement (PIIA) as a condition of employment. If
you improperly use or disclose any of Lyzr’s confidential or proprietary information, you
will be subject to disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment,
regardless of whether or not you receive any benefit from the use or disclosure.



Employment and Income Verification Requests and References
All inquiries for income or employment verification received by Lyzr from an outside
party regarding a present or former employee should be directed to your manager.


No other manager or employee is authorized to release references for current or former
employees. Lyzr will disclose only the dates of employment and title of the last position
held in response to reference or employment verification requests. If an employee
authorizes disclosure in writing, Lyzr will also provide the amount of salary or wage last
earned.




                               Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                   26
Lyzr Furnished Equipment or Materials
You are responsible for taking good care of the equipment or materials furnished to you
by Lyzr, which remain Lyzr’s property and should only be used for legitimate Lyzr
business.


Employees must return any Lyzr property in their possession upon separation of
employment or immediately upon any request by Lyzr.

Chapter Two:
General Employment Policies and Information

Equal Employment Opportunity and Diversity




Lyzr is committed to creating a fair and equitable, inclusive workplace that embraces
difference and fosters inclusion. As a result, we take our equal-employment principles
very seriously and work to ensure that all Lyzr employees are treated fairly and
respectfully. We strive to find ways to attract, develop and retain the talent needed to
meet business objectives, which starts with the effort to recruit and employ the most
highly qualified, diverse group of individuals we can.
Employment policies and decisions on employment and promotion are based on merit,
qualifications, performance, potential, and business needs. The decisions and criteria
governing the employment relationship with all employees are made without regard to
age, race, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding
or medical condition related to pregnancy or childbirth), gender identity or expression,
religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, legally protected genetic
information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other factor



                              Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                28
determined to be an unlawful basis for such decisions by applicable federal, state, or
local statutes (including medical marijuana cardholder status for Arizona applicants and
employees).


No legally protected characteristic will be a factor in decisions regarding any of the
following:
     Recruiting
   Hiring
   Compensation
   Scheduling
   Training
   Assignments
   Promotion/demotion
   Discipline
   Termination of employment, or
   Any other terms or conditions or privileges of employment.


Moreover, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws, Lyzr will make
reasonable accommodations for individuals with known disabilities, or for conditions
related to pregnancy (including but not limited to childbirth or lactation), provided that
such individuals are qualified to perform the essential functions and assignments of the
job, with or without accommodation, and provided that any accommodations would not
impose an undue hardship on Lyzr or creates a direct safety threat. Lyzr wishes to have
timely, good faith discussions with applicants or employees who make their condition
known to determine what accommodations may be appropriate. Any applicant or
employee who requires accommodation during the application process or in order to
perform the essential functions of the job should contact a Lyzr manager to request such
an accommodation.


Lyzr is also committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals,
regardless of their religious beliefs and practices or lack thereof. Consistent with this
commitment, Lyzr may provide a reasonable accommodation of an applicant’s or
employee’s sincerely held religious belief if the accommodation would resolve a conflict
between the individual’s religious beliefs or practices and a work requirement, unless
doing so would create an undue hardship for Lyzr.


If you have any reason to believe that you (or someone else) haven’t been treated in
accordance with this policy, you should immediately inform your manager, any other
Lyzr manager or officer, or the People Team.


                              Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                 29
Immigration Reform and Control Act




In compliance with the federal Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986 (IRCA), as
amended, and any state law requirements, if applicable, Lyzr is committed to employing
only individuals who are authorized to work in the United States. Lyzr participates in E-
Verify, which is an internet-based system that allows businesses to determine the
eligibility of their employees to work in the United States.

Each new employee, as a condition of employment, must complete the Employment
Eligibility Verification Form I-9 and present documentation establishing identity and
employment eligibility within three days of the employee’s date of hire. The Employment
Eligibility Verification Form I-9 and supporting documentation will be provided to E-Verify
for confirmation of eligibility for employment. A failure to complete the Employment
Eligibility Verification Form I-9 and present documentation establishing identity and
employment eligibility within three days of the employee’s date of hire may result in
termination of employment.


If an employee is authorized to work in this country for a limited time period, the
individual will be required to submit proof of renewed employment eligibility prior to
expiration of that period to remain employed by the company.




                               Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                 30
Open Door Policy




We have an open-door policy that seeks to encourage employees to participate in
decisions affecting them and their daily professional responsibilities. We encourage you
to make your concerns, questions, suggestions, and comments known to us. Whether
you have a question about any of our policies or programs, or a concern about a decision
affecting your job, you can make yourself heard so that your question or concern may be
addressed, and appropriate steps can be taken toward a resolution. If you have
concerns about potentially unlawful harassment, discrimination, or sexual assault, follow
the reporting procedures described in the Anti-Harassment and Discrimination policy in
Chapter One.




                              Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                31
Background and Reference Checks




To ensure that individuals who join Lyzr are well-qualified and to ensure that Lyzr
maintains a safe and productive work environment, it is our policy to conduct pre-
employment background checks on all applicants who accept an offer of employment.
Background checks may include verification of any information on the applicant’s
resume or application form.


All offers of employment are conditioned on receipt of a background check report that is
acceptable to Lyzr. All background checks are conducted in conformity with applicable
law, including the Fair Credit Reporting Act and state and federal privacy and anti-
discrimination laws. Reports are kept confidential and are only viewed by necessary
individuals involved in the hiring process.


If information obtained in a background check would lead Lyzr to deny employment, a
copy of the report will be provided to the applicant, and the applicant will have the
opportunity to dispute the report’s accuracy. Background checks may include a criminal
record check, although a criminal conviction does not automatically bar an applicant
from employment.


Additional checks such as a driving record or credit report may be made on applicants
for particular job categories if appropriate and job related.


Lyzr also reserves the right to conduct a background check for current employees to
determine eligibility for promotion or reassignment in the same manner as described
above.


                              Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                               32
Employment Categories




To address payroll, benefits, and other issues, employees are classified in various ways.
None of the classifications alter the at-will employment policy, as nothing in this
handbook (including this policy) alters the at-will employment policy.




A. General Categories
You will be assigned to one of the following categories at any given time. These
employment categories, which relate to the regular extent of your commitment, are as
follows:

   Regular, Full-Time employees are regularly scheduled to work 40 hours or more
   per week. Generally, these employees are eligible for certain benefits like Sick Pay,
   and are eligible to elect benefits coverage under the Lyzr Benefits Programs, subject
   to the terms, conditions and limitations of each benefits program.
   Regular, Part-Time employees are regularly scheduled to work less than 40 hours
   per week. Regular, Part-Time employees may be eligible for some benefits like Sick
   Pay (on a prorated basis), and but are not eligible to apply for coverage under Lyzr
   Benefits Programs, unless legally required, and subject to the terms, conditions, and
   limitations of each benefits program. Please refer to the Benefits Guidebook for
   additional information.




                              Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                33
B. Exempt and Non-exempt Status
In addition to being classified in accordance with the above categories, you will also be
classified as exempt or non-exempt. Exempt/non-exempt status corresponds to your
eligibility for overtime pay and certain other legal rights. This status is determined based
on applicable law and such factors as the nature of your work, your duties and
responsibilities, and your level and form of compensation.




C. Non-Exempt Employees
Are typically paid by the hour for each hour they work in a pay period and always receive
overtime pay in accordance with the applicable overtime rules. For overtime rules
applicable to you, please contact the People Team.




D. Exempt Employees
Are classified as such if they are not entitled to overtime under the federal (or, if
applicable, state) wage and hour laws. Employees in positions classified as Exempt are
generally paid a salary intended to compensate them fully for all hours worked each
week. Exempt employees are not compensated based on the number of hours worked
and do not receive overtime pay.




                               Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                  34
Access to Personnel Records




Lyzr maintains records for all employees. Most employee information may be accessed
only by appropriately authorized employer personnel. In addition, access to these
records may be granted to government agencies in accordance with the law, and to
other third parties by way of legal subpoena or court order.


Requests by current and former worksite employees to access employment records
should be made to the Lyzr’s senior management team. Lyzr will follow all state and
federal laws in granting an employee access to view and/or to receive a copy of their
personnel file.

Bring Your Own Device




Lyzr permits some employees to use their own personal mobile devices, including but
not limited to tablets, smartphones, and wearable technology (devices”), to perform
work for Lyzr or on Lyzr’s behalf. However, to protect Lyzr and its employees, any use of
a device for business purposes must conform to this policy as described below. In
addition, each user is responsible for using their device in a sensible, productive, ethical,
and lawful manner. Employees are prohibited from using personal computers for work-
related functions unless approved by the IT department.


All materials, data, communications and information, including but not limited to email
(both outgoing and incoming), telephone conversations and voice mail recordings,
instant messages, and internet and social media postings and activities (“content”)
created on, transmitted to, received or printed from, or stored or recorded on the device
for Lyzr’s business or on behalf of Lyzr is property of Lyzr, regardless of who owns the
device(s) used.

To access corporate email on a personal mobile device, we require the following:
   Passcode enabled and set to erase/factory reset device after 15 incorrect attempts
   Encryption enabled

Lyzr reserves the right to monitor, intercept, review, without further notice, all content
created on, transmitted to, received or printed from, or stored or recorded on the device
for Lyzr’s business or on behalf of Lyzr. Lyzr also maintains the authority to wipe the
device of any and all data upon termination. Therefore, employees should have no
expectation of privacy whatsoever in any content created on, transmitted to, received, or
printed from, or stored or recorded on the device for Lyzr’s business or on behalf of Lyzr.

Chapter Three:
Pay, Hours, and Leaves




Direct Deposit
You may elect to automatically deposit your paycheck into an account with almost any
bank, including the option of designating multiple accounts to which specified portions of
your paycheck may be directly deposited.

Funds are transferred electronically the same day as your regular payday.


Please be aware that posting of deposits and availability of funds varies by banking
institutions and is not under Lyzr’s control. If you have questions or encounter issues
with such a delay, you should contact your banking institution.




                              Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                 39
Payday and Paychecks
Technology allows you to receive pay and payday information without delay. If you
prefer not to direct deposit your paycheck, your check will be sent to your home
address.
Lyzr does not extend payroll advances, loans, or credit to employees.




Payroll Deductions
Lyzr categorizes payroll deductions as either voluntary or involuntary. Voluntary
deductions are taken if you enroll or are enrolled by default in any of the following
programs or services, assuming you are eligible.
Your first paycheck after Lyzr receives and processes your benefits enrollment may
reflect retroactive deductions for plans in which you enrolled that became effective on
your benefits eligibility date.

Involuntary deductions are those mandated by a government agency, or by any court
orders, liens, or wage assignments that the law may require us to recognize. Examples
of mandatory deductions that we take until the required amount is reached include, but
are not limited to, the following:


   Federal & State Income Tax Withholding
   Social Security (FICA)
   State Disability Insurance (SDI) (as applicable)
   Medicare
   State or local taxes (as applicable)
   Child support (as applicable)
   Garnishments (as applicable)

Your pay statement provides you with the current pay period and year-to-date payroll
deductions withheld from your paycheck. These deductions are reported each year on
your annual Form W-2, Wage & Tax Statement.


Employees will be reimbursed in full for any isolated, inadvertent, or improper
deductions, as defined by law. Lyzr will not make deductions which are prohibited by the
Fair Labor Standards Act or state laws from its exempt employees’ pay.



                              Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                               40
Hours and Timekeeping
Your regularly scheduled hours (as applicable) will be determined by your manager.
If you are a non-exempt employee, you must not work outside of your regularly
scheduled hours unless you have been pre-approved to do so by your manager. Failure
to obtain such pre-approval may result in disciplinary action, up to and including
termination of employment.


It is the responsibility of each non-exempt employee to accurately record their time on a
daily basis. If you are a non-exempt employee and work outside of your regularly
scheduled hours, regardless of whether or not you obtain your manager’s pre-approval
for such work, you must record all of your work time in ADP.

Non-Exempt employees are required to record the times when they actually start and
stop work during each workday.


Any other stops and starts must also be recorded, with the exception of those related to
paid rest periods. The start and stop times associated with paid rest periods need not be
recorded unless otherwise instructed in writing.


If you are a non-exempt employee, your manager will inform you of the time-keeping
system you are to use to record your time. You cannot record time for anyone but
yourself.


If there is an error in the recording of your time, you must contact your manager
immediately so that it can be corrected. Managers (or their designees) are responsible
for addressing any errors in time records and may not edit any time records without the
express written consent of the employee whose records are to be edited.

Any falsification of time records or misuse of a timekeeping system is strictly prohibited.
Violations of this policy may result in corrective action, up to and including termination of
employment.




                               Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                   41
Meal and Rest Breaks
Requirements and details regarding breaks for meals or rest are legally controlled by
state standards.



Overtime and Overtime Pay
Lyzr’s workweek, for payroll purposes, is defined as Sunday (12:01 am) through the
following Sunday (12:00 am). Non-exempt employees are eligible to receive overtime
pay for overtime work. What constitutes overtime work depends on where you work, as
there is a federal standard (i.e.,hours in excess of 40 per week) but also some state
standards that go beyond the federal standard (i.e., some states like California require
daily overtime). Please ask your manager for information about what constitutes
overtime for you.


If you are a non-exempt employee, you must not work overtime unless you have been
pre-approved to do so by your manager. Failure to obtain such pre-approval may result
in
disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment. However, overtime
worked and recorded as such will always be paid at the appropriate overtime rate.


Holidays, sick leave, UVT (Flexible Vacation Time), jury and witness leave, and other
leaves are not considered time actually worked when calculating hours worked for
overtime purposes.


Non-exempt employees will be paid at a rate of time and one-half of the employee’s
regular hourly rate for hours worked in excess of 40 hours in a workweek, unless state
law provides a greater benefit, in which case we will comply with state law.

Non-exempt employees who work on a designated Lyzr holiday will receive two-times
their normal hourly rate for the first 8 hours. All hours worked over 8 on a holiday will be
paid at a rate of time and one-half of the employee’s regular hourly rate.


Exempt employees are not eligible for overtime.




                               Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                  42
Expense Policy
To make expense reimbursements smooth and timely, all employees are requested to
submit reimbursable expense claims through the Company’s HRMS portal.
For expenses to be included in the same month’s payroll, please ensure that your claims
are raised and submitted on or before the 20th of each month. Once submitted, the claim
will automatically be routed to your Reporting Manager for review and approval.
Expenses that are submitted by the 20th and approved in the HRMS will be reimbursed
along with that month’s payroll. Claims submitted after the 20th, or those awaiting
approval, will be processed in the next payroll cycle, subject to approval.

To help avoid any delays, employees are encouraged to ensure that:
   Expense details are complete and accurate
   Valid supporting receipts are uploaded in the HRMS
   Expenses align with the Company’s expense guidelines

Please note that reimbursements can be processed only after manager approval is
completed in the HRMS. We appreciate your cooperation in following this process, as it
helps us ensure timely and accurate reimbursements for everyone.




Attendance & Tardiness, Paid and Unpaid
Time off (Excluding Leaves of Absence)
A. Attendance
If you expect to be absent or tardy to work, you must notify your manager as far ahead of
time as possible. If you fail to report for work for three consecutive scheduled workdays
without notifying your manager, you may be considered to have abandoned your job and
voluntarily resigned your employment without notice.




                               Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                               43
B. Holidays
We observe major US holidays to allow our team to recharge and spend time with family:

    New Year's Day (January 1)
    Martin Luther King’s Birthday (3rd Monday in January)*
    Washington’s Birthday (3rd Monday in February)*
    Memorial Day (Last Monday in May)
    Juneteenth National Independence Day (June 19)
    Independence Day (July 4)
    Columbus Day (2nd Monday in October)*
    Veterans’ Day (November 11)*
    Labor Day (First Monday in September)
    Thanksgiving Day (Fourth Thursday in November)
    Day after Thanksgiving (Friday after Thanksgiving)*
    Christmas Day (December 25)

*Optional days can be used for other personal days.
-When a holiday falls on a weekend, it will be observed on the closest weekday.


All veterans and reserve-duty service members may elect to take a paid holiday on both
Memorial Day (if the employee’s job duties would otherwise require the employee to
work on the
company-wide holiday) and Veteran’s Day.



C. Flexible Vacation Time Off (UVT)
Lyzr offers paid Flexible Vacation to its employees because it trusts its employees to
manage their work time in a way that maximizes their job satisfaction and their
productivity. This policy gives employees the flexibility to take time away from work
when they need to recharge and still manage the completion of their work. Employees
are expected to complete all job duties and meet work-related deadlines and
performance expectations. Unsatisfactory job performance or excessive use of Flexible
Vacation may result in an employee no longer being eligible for Flexible Vacation. In
addition, abuse of this policy may result in discipline, including termination.


There is no payout, accrual, or rollover of Flexible Vacation time. Flexible Vacation time
is not “earned.”



                                Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                               44
To request time off, submit your dates in Gusto (or any replacement system) with as
much advance notice as possible, at a minimum, one week prior to the date(s)
requested. For time off in excess of one week, submit your request at least one month in
advance. The use of Flexible Vacation is approved on a first-come, first-serve basis, with
managers approving requests according to business and position needs and the order
in which the requests were submitted. Failure to request time off sufficiently in advance
may result in denial of your request. Flexible Vacation can only be taken on days that an
employee is scheduled to work. Managers may establish “blackout” dates due to
business needs.


If you need to be out of the office unexpectedly, notify your manager as soon as possible
on the day you are out. Failure to provide timely notice to your manager will result in the
absence being recorded as unexcused and may result in disciplinary action.


Employees will typically take 3-4 weeks off per year, but this will vary by employee, by
year and by business needs. In general, it’s up to the employee and their manager to
ensure that the employee continues to meet work-related deadlines and other time
commitments of the job.

Some types of absences are protected by law and it is critical that Lyzr be able to track
those types of absences to ensure that no disciplinary or performance management
decision is made based on a protected absence. Flexible Vacation is not a protected
absence. Lyzr will track your Flexible Vacation and employees must continue to
separately request Sick Pay, Parental Leave, Jury Duty, Bereavement, Volunteer Time

Off, and Military Leave as well. Time off due to leaves of absence for these reasons, as
well as family medical leave under FMLA or state laws and leaves of absence related to
a workers’ compensation claim or disability accommodation, are handled separately.
Flexible Vacation may not be used for other types of absences unless specifically noted.




                               Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                 45
D. Paid Sick Leave
Except as otherwise provided in an applicable state addendum below or as otherwise
required by law, we offer up to forty (40) hours of paid sick leave to full-time and part-
time employees, which can be used for purposes including your own illness or a family
member’s illness that prevents you from reporting to work, and potentially other reasons
depending on state and local laws. Consult your state addendum at the end of this
handbook if included or contact the People Team for more information.


Each employee receives 40 hours of paid sick leave upon hire, and there is no waiting
period before you may utilize sick leave hours. Each January 1 after the year of hire,
each employee’s sick leave bank will be replenished to 40 hours if applicable; unused
sick leave may be carried forward from one year to the next up to a maximum of 80
hours unless otherwise required by law.


Lyzr will reinstate accrued, but unused Paid Sick Leave to employees who separate but
are rehired within one year from their date of separation. Under no circumstances may
sick leave of any employee be converted to cash, be paid out upon separation, or be
used as PTO or holiday time, unless required by state or local law.
Lyzr complies with all state and local law regarding Paid Sick Leave. To the extent any
applicable paid sick time/leave ordinance provides any greater rights than set forth in
this policy, such provisions are incorporated by reference. If you have further questions,
please review the applicable state supplement at the end of this handbook and/or
contact the People Team.




E. Bereavement Leave
Five (5) paid days off are available (per occurrence) if a death occurs in your immediate
family. Please see your manager to arrange the appropriate time off. Immediate family
includes spouse, child, parent, brother, sister, grandparent, mother-in-law, father-in-law,
domestic partner, and domestic partner’s mother or father, unless otherwise provided
by applicable law.




                               Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                 46
F. Voting Time
We encourage all employees to take part in the electoral process. In most cases, you
can vote before or after working hours. If scheduling difficulties makes this impractical,
you may be able to take unpaid time off with prior approval from your manager.
Applicable state legal requirements will be followed.


G. Time Off for Jury and Witness Duty
Lyzr encourages employees to fulfill their civic duties related to jury and witness service.
If you’re legally obliged to serve jury duty or appear as a witness, inform your manager of
your obligation as soon as you’re notified. Time off for jury or witness duty is paid for up to
4 weeks per calendar year. If jury or witness duty lasts longer, the time away beyond 4
weeks will be unpaid. Based on business necessity, you or your manager may choose to
ask the court to have you excused. If you’re away from work because of jury or witness
duty, you’ll need to present evidence of such duty to Lyzr when you return. Be sure to
obtain documentation from the court. Applicable legal requirements will be followed.


You must report to work during your regular hours if you are dismissed from the jury or if,
for any reason, you are not required to remain at court.


H. State-Specific Time Off
Many states provide for additional paid and unpaid time off. See the applicable
addendum at the end of this handbook or contact your manager and/or People Team for
additional information.




                                Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                    47
I. Leaves of Absence

Generally
Employees who need to be absent from work for reasons other than personal time or
vacation, may request a Leave of Absence. Generally, and except as otherwise
described in this handbook, state addendums, or as required by law, leaves of absence
are granted without pay, but an employee may use sick leave, as appropriate, to provide
compensation during an otherwise unpaid leave. Sick leave will be coordinated with any
government paid leave benefits that an employee may be eligible for to ensure that the
employee receives no more than 100% of the employee’s base pay. Leaves may be
granted for a variety of reasons, including (without limitation): your medical disability, a
serious health condition of you or a qualifying family member, pregnancy, bonding with a
newborn or adopted child, military leave, or personal leaves Lyzr deems compelling, or
as otherwise permitted by federal, state, or local law.

To request a leave of absence, you need to contact your manager as soon as
practicable who will help you submit the leave of absence request.

Your health insurance benefits and arrangements for your portion, if any, of premium
payments may be affected by your leave of absence.


If your health benefits are terminated and you elect COBRA

Should your regular health insurance benefits be terminated as a result of your leave,
you will be eligible to continue these benefits pursuant to COBRA. A separate COBRA
enrollment package will be sent to your home address following any such loss of
coverage. Your health insurance benefits will be continued pursuant to COBRA should
you properly elect, and continue to remain eligible for, COBRA continuation coverage.
Nothing in this handbook is a guarantee of COBRA coverage, as you remain solely
responsible for meeting certain eligibility requirements under COBRA in order to
maintain COBRA coverage through Lyzr.


With COBRA continuation coverage, unless you return to work on the first day of the
month, your COBRA medical, dental and/or vision benefits will continue to the end of the
month during which you return to work and your regular health insurance benefits will
resume on the 1st of the month following the date you return to work. You will be
responsible for paying for that month’s COBRA continuation coverage on or before the
last day of the grace period provided pursuant to COBRA.



                               Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                  48
If your health benefits are terminated and you do not elect COBRA


If your regular health insurance benefits are terminated as a result of your leave of
absence and you do not elect to continue them pursuant to COBRA, your benefits
automatically will be reinstated the first of the month following your return-to-work
date or upon rehire.



Absent Extenuating Circumstances
Failure to return to work within three (3) consecutive days after the expiration of an
approved leave may be considered a voluntary resignation.




J. Military Duty
Lyzr is committed to protecting the job rights of employees absent on military leave. If
you join a branch of the Armed Forces of the United States or you are a member of a
reserve component of the U.S. Armed Forces or the National Guard, you may be entitled
to take a leave to perform military duties. The Uniformed Services Employment and
Reemployment Rights Act of 1994 (USERRA) provides enhanced leave rights and job
protections for employees absent for military duty. USERRA prohibits discrimination in
employment and retaliation against any person who was, is, or applies to be a member
of a uniformed service, or who performs or has an obligation to perform service in a
uniformed service. A number of state laws also provide leave rights for employees
requiring time off for military duty.


At Lyzr, you will be paid for up to 4 weeks per year for Military Leave. Additional unpaid
leave will be provided as allowed by applicable federal and state laws. To be eligible for
military leave, employees must provide advance notice of their service obligations,
unless they are prevented from providing such notice due to military necessity or it is
otherwise impossible or unreasonable to provide such notice. You must provide a copy
of your orders and/or training notices, or any other reasonable form of notice of your
military duty to qualify for paid leave.




                                 Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                              49
K. Pregnancy Related Leave
Certain states provide specific leave rights for pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical
conditions. Please contact your manager for more information.


L. Parental Leave Policy
Certain states provide specific leave rights for pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical
conditions. Please contact your manager for more information.

Purpose/Objective
The purpose of paid parental leave is to provide qualified employees with compensation
while they care for and bond with a newborn or a newly adopted or newly placed child.
Except as otherwise described in an applicable state addendum or as required by
applicable law, Lyzr will provide up to three (3) weeks of paid parental leave to
employees following the birth of an employee’s child or the placement of a child with an
employee in connection with adoption or foster care. Paid parental leave must be taken
in a single block of time within one year of the birth, adoption, or foster care placement.

Eligibility
Eligible employees must meet the following criteria:

   Have been employed with the company for at least 90 days
   Be a full- or part-time, regular employee (temporary employees and interns are not
   eligible for this benefit).
   Part-Time employees' time would be prorated based on weekly hours worked.

Amount, Time Frame and Duration of Paid Parental Leave
    Eligible employees receive a maximum of three weeks of paid parental leave per
   birth, adoption or placement of a child/children. The fact that a multiple birth,
   adoption or placement occurs (e.g., the birth of twins or adoption of siblings) does not
   increase the three-week total amount of paid parental leave granted for that event.
   Each week of paid parental leave is compensated at 100 percent of the employee’s
   regular, base weekly pay (weekly compensation will be based on an average in the
   event the employee’s hours fluctuate). Paid parental leave is paid on regularly
   scheduled pay dates.




                               Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                 50
   Approved paid parental leave may be taken at any time during the 12-month period
   immediately following the birth, adoption or placement of a child with the employee
   and in a single block of time. Paid parental leave may not be used or extended
   beyond this 12-month time frame.
   In the event of an employee who has given birth, the weeks of paid parental leave will
   commence at the conclusion of any short-term disability leave or other paid benefit
   provided to the employee for the employee’s own medical recovery following
   childbirth.
   In any other scenario, paid parental leave will be paid out after any other applicable
   paid leave, unless intermittent leave has been elected.
   Employees must take paid parental leave in one continuous period of leave and must
   use paid parental leave during the 12-month time frame indicated above. Any
   unused paid parental leave is forfeited at the end of the 12-month time frame.
   Intermittent leave may be approved in certain circumstances.
   Upon termination of the individual’s employment at the company, they will not be
   paid for any unused paid parental leave for which they were eligible.


Coordination with Other Policies
   Paid parental leave taken under this policy runs concurrently with leave under the
   FMLA or applicable state law and counts towards the employee’s FMLA or state
   leave entitlement, if legally permissible. All other requirements and provisions under
   the FMLA or applicable state law apply.
   The company maintains all benefits for employees during the paid parental leave
   period just as if they were taking any other paid leave such as Unlimited Vacation or
   paid sick leave.


Requests for Paid Parental Leave
The employee must provide their supervisor and the People Team with notice of the
request for leave at least 30 days prior to the proposed date of the leave (or if the leave
was not foreseeable, as soon as possible). The employee must timely complete the
necessary forms, and if possible, coordinate timing with their manager.




                               Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                 51
M. Other Family and Medical Leave
If the absence you have from work is for a serious health condition-either yours or a
qualifying family member-you may be eligible for leave under applicable law.



N. Unprotected Personal Leaves
Lyzr intends to recognize that reasonable requests for periods of time off beyond those
provided by Lyzr’s other leave provisions or as required by law may be honored on a
case-by-case basis in the company’s sole discretion. Employees should discuss their
request with their manager and then request their personal leave of absence with their
manager.


Re-employment is not guaranteed. Following completion of the leave, if re-employment
is not possible or unreasonable due to business conditions, the employee will be
terminated as a voluntary termination. Returning to the same job following a personal
leave cannot be guaranteed.


During a personal leave, employees do not accrue sick leave and employees are not
eligible for other employee benefits except as required by law. With regard to stock
vesting, vesting will not continue during the non-statutory personal leave of absence. A
number of employee benefits and programs are affected when an employee is on a
personal leave of absence.




                              Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                               52
Chapter Four:
Benefits Required By Law




You are entitled to certain benefits under the law, regardless of your position, subject to
meeting certain conditions. These mandated benefits include those described in this
chapter (if applicable).




                               Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                 53
State Disability Insurance
Some states (such as California, Hawaii, New Jersey, New York and Rhode Island) and
the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico provide a form of limited disability insurance. If you
work in one of these areas, you may be eligible for limited disability insurance payments
if you cannot work because of a sickness or injury not caused by your job (job-related
conditions fall under workers’ compensation). The terms and amount of disability
coverage are subject to state laws and vary from state to state. Some states, such as
California, require Lyzr to make deductions from your paycheck to fund the disability
insurance benefits program. To receive disability benefits, file a claim with the state
disability insurance agency.



Workers’ Compensation Insurance
As of your date of hire, you are covered by workers’ compensation insurance. Please
don’t forget to immediately report to your manager all injuries sustained while working.
Please note that workers’ compensation covers only work-related injuries and illnesses.
You will not be eligible to receive workers’ compensation benefits for injuries that might
happen if you voluntarily participate in an off-duty recreational, social, or athletic activity
that does not constitute a part of your work-related duties.



Unemployment Insurance
If you become unemployed, you may be eligible for unemployment insurance, a weekly
benefit while you are out of work. For information on filing a claim, please contact your
state’s unemployment department.



Social Security
You will see deductions on your paycheck for FICA, an acronym that stands for Federal
Insurance Contributions Act, otherwise known as Social Security and Medicare. This
deduction represents your contribution toward your Social Security benefit. In addition to
supplemental retirement benefits, Social Security offers certain disability and/or
Medicare coverage. Contact your nearest Social Security Administration office for
further details.


                                Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                    54
COBRA
If you or your covered dependents lose eligibility for regular group medical, dental, vision
benefits and/or Health Care FSA, you may be eligible to continue your coverage under
COBRA. COBRA allows you to continue receiving these benefits on a temporary basis in
certain situations where coverage under the Benefits Plan would otherwise end.




Retirement Benefits
 Lyzr currently does not offer a 401(k) or retirement plan benefit but plans to do so no
later than January 1, 2026. However some states require that employers offer state-
provided retirement plan options. For employees in those states we will provide the
state-mandated retirement plan options.
