CALIFORNIA
ADDENDUM




 Lyzr AI India Private Limited.   57
Introduction
The following are some of the Company’s policies unique to California, and only
California, employees. To the extent that any policy contained in the Handbook is
contrary to state or local law, the Company will follow applicable state or local laws. This
includes a summary of the most common types of leave available under state law. If you
have questions about whether your particular situation is covered, please contact your
supervisor.


A. California Family Rights Act
The California Family Rights Act (“CFRA”) provides eligible employees the opportunity to
take unpaid, job-protected leave for certain specified reasons. The maximum amount of
leave employees may use under this policy is 12 weeks within a 12-month period. When
applicable, CFRA leave runs concurrent with FMLA leave.


To be eligible for CFRA leave, employees must:
    Have worked at least 12 months for the Company in the preceding seven years
    (limited exceptions apply to the seven-year requirement).
    Have worked at least 1,250 hours for the Company over the 12 months preceding
    the date the leave would commence.

All periods of absence from work due to or necessitated by service in the uniformed
services are counted as hours worked in determining eligibility.


CFRA leave may be taken for any of the following reasons:
   To care for or bond with a newborn child.
    To care for or bond with a child placed with the employee and/or the employee’s
    registered domestic partner for adoption or foster care.
    To care for an immediate family member (employee’s spouse, parent, parent-in-law,
    registered domestic partner, child or registered domestic partner’s child of any age,
    sibling, grandparent, or grandchild) with a serious health condition.
    Because of the employee’s serious health condition that makes the employee unable
    to perform his or her job (with the exception of pregnancy, which is covered under
    Pregnancy Disability Leave and does not run concurrently with CFRA).
    A qualifying military exigency related to the covered active duty or call to covered
    active duty of an employee’s spouse, domestic partner, child (of any age), or parent
    in the United States Armed Forces.



                               Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                  58
Such leave may be taken in a single block of time, intermittently (in separate blocks of
time), or by reducing the normal work schedule. Employees who require intermittent or
reduced-schedule leave must try to schedule their leave so that it will not unduly disrupt
the Company's operations.
Intermittent leave is permitted in intervals of at least one hour or at the same intervals as
provided in other relevant policies, whichever increments are smaller.


Depending on the purpose of the leave request, employees may choose to use accrued
paid sick time concurrently with some or all of the CFRA leave. To use paid leave
concurrently with CFRA leave, eligible employees must comply with the Company's
normal procedures for the applicable paid-leave policy (e.g., call-in procedures,
advance notice).

Employee paid sick time accruals will continue while paid leave is used during periods of
CFRA absence and in accordance with those individual policies.

Employee paid-leave accruals will not continue during unpaid periods of CFRA absence
or when only disability payments are being received.


B. California Privacy Rights Act
California employees are entitled to certain protections regarding their private
information under the California Privacy Rights Act. See Lyzr’s separate privacy policy
for California employees or communication with the People Team for more details.


C. State Leave Laws
California employees are eligible for leave as set forth below.*

1. Paid Family Leave
An employee who is off work to care for a child, spouse, parent, parent-in-law,
grandparent, grandchild, sibling, spouse, registered domestic partner or child of a
registered domestic partner with a serious health condition, or to bond with a new child
entering the family by birth, adoption, or foster care placement, may be eligible to receive
up to eight weeks of paid family leave benefits through the California Paid Family Leave
(“PFL”) program, which is administered by the Employment Development Department
(“EDD”).




                               Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                   59
These benefits are financed solely through employee contributions to the PFL program.
That program is solely responsible for determining if an employee is eligible for such
benefits. There is generally a waiting period during which time no PFL benefits are
available. The EDD can provide additional information about any applicable waiting
period. If you need to take time off work to care for a child, spouse, parent, parent-in-law,
grandparent, grandchild, sibling, spouse, registered domestic partner or child of a
registered domestic partner with a serious health condition or to bond with a new child,
please inform your supervisor, and you will be given information about the EDD’s PFL
program and how to apply for benefits. Employees also may contact their local EDD
office for further information.

* This is a nonexclusive list and the Company will provide any leave required by federal or California law.


When an employee applies for PFL benefits, the HR Department will determine if the
employee has any accrued but unused paid time available. If the employee has accrued
but unused paid time available, then the employee will be required to use up to two
weeks of such time before becoming eligible for PFL benefits.
PFL is a state-sponsored payment program and not a leave entitlement. Employees
should request a leave of absence under the appropriate leave policy or policies that are
applicable to them.



2. Pregnancy Disability Leave
California employees are eligible for up to four months of pregnancy disability leave
(“PDL”) for periods of disability associated with an employee’s pregnancy, childbirth, and
related medical conditions. Employees who are regularly scheduled to work less than 40
hours per week receive a prorated amount of PDL determined by comparing their
regular work schedule to a 40-hour work week. PDL can be taken on an intermittent or
reduced leave schedule where medically necessary.


All eligible employees must produce a written doctor’s certificate verifying the period of
disability. Employees must give as much advance notice as possible of the need for
leave. In the case of a normal pregnancy, that generally means at least 30 days’ notice
but in the case of an emergency, as much notice as is practicable under the
circumstances. PDL is unpaid. However, during PDL you must use any accrued sick
leave, and you may use any accrued vacation. Accrued sick leave and vacation are used
as part of the PDL, not in addition to such leave. During the period of disability, you may
be eligible for disability pay benefits. Please refer to the applicable plan documents for
details on eligibility, benefit amounts, and other particulars.


                                     Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                           60
Upon completion of PDL, you shall be reinstated to your original position, or an equivalent
one. To facilitate your return to work, we ask that you provide us with two weeks’
advance notification of your intended return date.



3. Crime Victims Leave
Employees who are the victims of crimes or whose immediate family members are
victims of crimes are entitled to take leave to attend judicial proceedings related to the
crime. For purposes of this policy, “immediate family member” includes a spouse,
registered domestic partner, children, children of a registered domestic partner,
stepchildren, sisters, brothers, stepsisters, stepbrothers, half-siblings, parents, and
stepparents.

In addition, employees who are victims of crimes can take leave for the following
purposes:
    Obtain any relief, including a temporary restraining order or an injunction, to help
    ensure their own or their children’s health, safety, or welfare;
   Seek medical attention for related injuries;
   Obtain services from a domestic violence shelter or program or from a rape crisis
   center;
   Undergo psychological counseling; or
   Participate in safety planning or other activities, including temporary or permanent
   relocation, to guard against future incidents.


Employees should give as much advance notice as possible of the need for Crime
Victims Leave. The Company may require appropriate documentation verifying the need
for leave.



4. Volunteer Firefighter, Reserve Peace Officer,
   and Emergency Rescue Personnel
Non-exempt employees will be granted time off without pay to perform emergency
duties as a volunteer firefighter, reserve peace officer, or emergency rescue personnel.
Employees who are volunteer firefighters also are eligible for leave of up to 14 days per
calendar year for fire or law enforcement training. Exempt employees who work any
portion of a work week in which they also perform such emergency duties or training will
receive their full salary for that work week. Otherwise, exempt employees will be
granted time off without pay.


                               Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                 61
5. Children’s School-Related Activities
Employees who are parents, guardians, or custodial grandparents for a child in a
licensed day-care facility or a school (kindergarten through grade 12) are entitled to up
to 40 hours of leave per year, but no more than eight hours per calendar month, to
participate in school-related activities involving their children.


The leave is subject to all of the following conditions:
 1. Time off under this policy can only be used by parents, guardians, grandparents,
    stepparents, foster parents or a person who stands in loco parentis to one or more
    children of the age to attend kindergarten through grade 12 or a licensed childcare
    provider;
 2. The amount of time off for school or childcare activities described below cannot
    exceed a total of 40 hours each year;
 3. Covered employees can use the time off to find, enroll or reenroll a child in a school
    or with a licensed childcare provider or to participate in activities of the child’s school
    or licensed childcare provider. The time off for these purposes cannot exceed eight
    hours in any calendar month. Employees planning to take time off for these purposes
    must provide reasonable advance notice to their supervisor.
 4. Covered employees can also use time off to address a childcare provider or school
    emergency if the employee gives notice to the employer. A childcare provider or
    school emergency means that the employee’s child cannot remain in a school or
    with a childcare provider due to one of the following:
         The school or childcare provider has requested that the child be picked up, or
         has an attendance policy (excluding planned holidays) that prohibits the child
         from attending or requires the child to be picked up from the school or childcare
        provider;
        Behavioral or discipline problems;
        Closure or unexpected unavailability of the school or childcare provider,
        excluding planned holidays; or
        A natural disaster, including, but not limited to, fire, earthquake or flood.




                                Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                    62
Employees must:

   Provide their supervisor with documentation from the school or licensed childcare
   provider verifying that they were engaged in these child-related activities on the day
   and time of the absence.
   If more than one parent is employed by the Company, the first employee to request
   such leave will receive the time off. Another parent will receive the time off only if the
   leave is approved by his or her supervisor.
   Use their paid sick time in order to receive compensation for this time off.
   Employees who do not have paid sick time available must take the time off without
   pay.


In the case of the child being suspended from school, there is no limit to the leave time
the employee may take to deal with the formal suspension proceedings although such
indefinite leave is not available to custodial grandparents. The Company may require
written documentation concerning the activity from the school or licensed day-care
facility.



6. National Guard Leave
The Company supports employees who serve in the armed forces, including in the
National Guard. Eligible employees who must be absent from work for service in the
National Guard are entitled to take a military leave of absence. Please reach out to your
supervisor for more information regarding this and other available military leaves of
absence.



7. Organ/Bone Marrow Donation Leave
An employee who has been employed for at least 90 days may request a leave of
absence for up to 30 business days in any one calendar year period to undergo a
medical procedure to donate an organ and up to five business days in any one calendar
year period to donate bone marrow. Employees must provide a certification from their
physician regarding the purpose and length of each leave requested. An employee must
use up to five days of earned but unused paid sick time off for bone marrow donation and
up to two weeks of unused paid sick time off for organ donation leave. If the employee
does not have sufficient accrued paid sick time, the remaining leave time for such
procedure shall be paid; however, the paid time off shall not exceed 30 days or five days
for bone marrow donation. Subject to certain requirements, an employee is also entitled


                               Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                   63
to an additional unpaid leave of absence, not exceeding 30 business days in a one-year
period, to an employee who is an organ donor, for the purpose of donating the
employee’s organ to another person. Organ and/or bone marrow donation leave will not
be designated as FMLA or CFRA leave time. Employees will receive health benefits for
the duration of their organ and/or bone marrow donation leave and upon returning from
such leave will have a right to return to the same or equivalent positions they held before
such leave.



D. Additional Enforcement Information
In addition to the Company’s general complaint procedure, employees should also be
aware that the federal Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC) and the
California Department of Fair Employment and Housing (DFEH) investigate and prosecute
complaints of harassment and discrimination in employment. Employees have the right to
report allegations of illegal discrimination to the appropriate agency, and retaliation for
exercising this right is prohibited by the Company.



E. State Disability Insurance
All employees contribute towards State Disability Insurance. If you are disabled while on
the job, you may be eligible for benefits. Contact your supervisor for more information. You
may also check the website of the EDD for more information.



F. Lactation in the Workplace
The Company provides a reasonable amount of break time to accommodate an
employee’s need to express breast milk for the employee’s infant child. The Company will
make a reasonable effort to provide the employee with the use of a room or other location
(other than a bathroom) in close proximity to the employee’s work area for the employee
to express milk in private. Such space will meet the requirements of the California Labor
Code, including a surface on which to place a breast pump and personal items, a place to
sit, access to electricity, a sink with running water, and a refrigerator for storing breast
milk.
All employees have a right to request a lactation accommodation. The general process for
requesting such an accommodation is as follows:
   The employee should submit a written request to her supervisor.
   Within five business days the Company will respond to any request for an
   accommodation.


                               Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                 64
   The Company will also engage in the interactive process to determine an appropriate
   accommodation, including lactation break and/or lactation location.


If in response to a lactation accommodation the Company does not provide a requested
lactation break or lactation location, the Company will provide the employee with a written
response identifying the basis upon which the request is being denied.
The Company will not retaliate against any employee for enforcing her right to a lactation
break, lactation location, or lactation accommodation.
Employees have the right to file a complaint with the labor commissioner for any violation
of rights provided under Chapter 3.8 of the California Labor Code regarding lactation
accommodations.



G. Overtime
All non-exempt employees who work more than eight hours in one workday or more than
40 hours in one work week will receive overtime pay computed as follows:

   Overtime at the rate of 1.5 times the employee’s regular rate of pay for all hours
   worked in excess of 40 in any one work week.
   Overtime at the rate of one and 1.5 times the employee’s regular rate of pay for the
   hours worked in excess of eight hours in any one workday up to 12 hours, and for the
   first eight hours worked on the seventh day of work in any one work week.
   Overtime at the rate of double the employee’s regular rate of pay for all hours worked
   in excess of 12 hours in one workday, and for all hours worked in excess of eight on
   the seventh day of work in any one work week.


1. Reporting Time
A non-exempt employee who reports to work at the Company’s request, whether for a
regularly-scheduled shift or otherwise, but is furnished less than a full day’s work, will be
paid for half of the usual or scheduled day’s work, but in no event less than two hours or
more than four hours, at the employee’s regular rate, without regard for the number of
hours actually worked, unless the reasons for lack of work are beyond the Company’s
control. Reporting time pay will not be paid to an employee on paid standby status who is
called to perform assigned work at a time other than the employee’s scheduled
reporting time. Reporting time hours are not counted as hours worked for overtime
purposes beyond the time in which the work is actually performed.




                               Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                   65
2. Call-Back Pay
A non-exempt employee who is called back for a second work period in a workday and
is given less than two hours of work will be paid a minimum of two hours of pay at the
employee’s regular rate of pay for the second work period, without regard to the number
of hours actually worked, unless the reasons for any failure to furnish two hours of work
are beyond the Company’s control. Call-back time is not counted as hours worked for
overtime purposes beyond the time in which work is actually performed.



H. Final Paycheck
An employee who resigns with at least 72 hours of notice will receive their final paycheck
at the end of their last day of work. If an employee’s employment is terminated
involuntarily, their final paycheck will be available immediately upon termination.




                              Lyzr AI India Private Limited.                                66
